name: aspace-claude-video-adapter
seam: contract only — the adapter never imports upstream code; it only reads the skill tree and reports
surface: python3 aspace-claude-video-adapter/validate.py --version -> skill version + gel + adapter version
python3 aspace-claude-video-adapter/validate.py validate [path] -> structure check of the skill tree (SKILL.md, 10 scripts, plugin versions, LICENSE, hooks); exit 0/2; stdlib only
python3 aspace-claude-video-adapter/validate.py doctor -> offline posture (binaries present/absent, API keys present/absent as booleans only, telemetry posture); informative, exit 0
python3 aspace-claude-video-adapter/validate.py env -> offline environment the adapter enforces

telemetry.note: No posthog/sentry/mixpanel/amplitude/segment anywhere. Pyannote metrics disabled by the upstream code itself (PYANNOTE_METRICS_ENABLED=0 in local_whisperx.py). Cloud backends (Groq api.groq.com, OpenAI api.openai.com, Gemini generativelanguage.googleapis.com) only run with an explicit user key and a user-triggered transcription; the adapter never calls them. yt-dlp/ffmpeg only run on a user-triggered /watch; the adapter never invokes them.
